Tooling failure in this session: web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx backend) returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt; html.duckduckgo.com and lite.duckduckgo.com timed out; Bing returned identical cached generic results unrelated to the query (pages about the word 'mother', a denim brand, a film) for three different queries, so its output is unusable and was discarded rather than treated as evidence; Google returned only a redirect/consent interstitial. The OFAC Sanctions List Search page (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) was reachable but is a JavaScript form - a plain HTTP GET cannot execute a name lookup, so no SDN/Non-SDN match or non-match could be established. Therefore sanctions_hit, court_cases, rating, news_risk and rf_supply are all null because nothing was verified, NOT because a negative check was performed. No claim in this record should be read as 'clean'. Per project rules, absence of a sanctions hit is not asserted here; the company is a large well-known Indian dairy/FMCG entity (a unit of the National Dairy Development Board ecosystem) but that is background knowledge, not a sourced finding, and is deliberately not entered as a fact. Required follow-up before any verdict: (1) run the name through OFAC SDN/Non-SDN, UN Consolidated, EU consolidated, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List search interfaces with a working browser/API; (2) query eCourts / NCLT / Delhi HC and other High Court cause lists for party role and status; (3) check CIBIL/CRISIL/ICRA/CARE public rating actions with dates; (4) search Indian business press for regulatory actions (FSSAI, CCI, consumer cases) with dates; (5) check customs/export records for Russia/CIS destinations. No sanctions, court, rating, news or Russia/CIS-supply finding is recorded either way.
